summary: Automation graph memory between runs: the automation.state table (tenant, automation, key, JSON value up to 16 KiB, optional expiry; at most 10,000 live keys per automation, expired keys swept in the background), the built-in set_state node (key template, CEL value, ttl 1m–365d or delete; outcomes set and failed with codes state_value_too_large, state_value_invalid, state_key_invalid, state_limit_exceeded, state_ttl_invalid; written in the step's transaction; captured by a dry run), state.get(key) / state.has(key) in the CEL of a step (lazy lookup, map get/has member functions; dry run reads the saved graph's memory and never writes), engine Memory API and MCP operations (automation_state_list/get tools, automation.state.set/delete changes, mcpops.WithMemory), automations.state_list/state_set/state_delete RPC and a memory panel in the graph settings of the editor (settingsSlot). Fixes mcpops after the Authoring.Validate signature change.
